trajectory_summary: The call opens with the customer doing most of the selling-herself work — she's pre-qualified, roof-cleared, credit-qualified, and even compliments Ion unprompted — and the rep essentially rides that momentum to a booked appointment without much active steering. Energy is mostly stagnant on the rep's side (minimal probing, bare acknowledgments) while the customer repeatedly hands over rich material — battery needs, contract-term anxiety, AI-vetting behavior — that goes unused. It still lands as a booked appointment because the customer was already sold on the category, not because of rep execution.
